'''2002 Endor Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG regional held in Booster Pack Gaming in June 2002. [[Keith Watabayashi]] won it. It is known from Keith Watabayashi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3737">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-13-gens-endor-regional-reportd3737/ gens-endor-regional-report], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 13 June 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-13-gens-endor-regional-reportd3737/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 June 2002<ref name="tr-d3728" />
* '''Site:''' Booster Pack Gaming
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Keith Watabayashi]]
